name: @scalar/nextjs-api-reference
description: Next.js API route handler to serve beautiful, interactive API documentation from OpenAPI/Swagger documents.
author: Scalar (https://github.com/scalar)

scalarReadme.title: Scalar API Reference Handler for Next.js

extraContent.headline: Quickstart
extraContent.content:
```bash
npm install @scalar/nextjs-api-reference
```

Put your OpenAPI description in `public/openapi.json` and create:

```typescript
// app/scalar/route.ts
import { ApiReference } from '@scalar/nextjs-api-reference'

export const GET = ApiReference({ url: '/openapi.json' })
```

Open `/scalar`. To embed Scalar in your application layout, follow the [App Router page guide](https://scalar.com/products/api-references/integrations/nextjs).
